hook: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 model scored 12% on 206 expert tasks.

sections.voiceover: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 model scored 12% on 206 expert tasks.
sections.visual_cue: Animated bar graphic displaying 12% benchmark score alongside 206 evaluation task count badge.

sections.voiceover: On November 2, 2026, researchers tested 20 models across 11 professional domains. AI agents had up to 8 hours to finish each task. Which rival model came closest to that 12% score?
sections.visual_cue: Split layout showing November 2, 2026 date badge, 20 models grid icon, and 8 hour clock timer graphic.
sections.animation_cue: Sequential icon highlight for 20 models and 11 domains

sections.voiceover: However, Google's Gemini 4 Carbon reached 10.9% at a third of the cost.
sections.visual_cue: Comparison screen contrasting 10.9% score with 1/3 price badge for Gemini 4 Carbon.

sections.voiceover: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon took second place across the 206 tasks. Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 still leads with its 12% result.
sections.visual_cue: Ranked leaderboard showing Claude Opus 5.5 at 12% and Gemini 4 Carbon at 10.9% with price efficiency tag.

sections.voiceover: Claude Opus 5.5 retains the top score of 12%.
sections.visual_cue: Minimalist graphic highlighting Claude Opus 5.5 with 12% final rank badge.
